content.comment_body: Hello, I'm experiencing the same issue with my new [product_name]; previously, with my old [product_name], I was able to enter the message center phone number. With the newer model, this option is missing, resulting in the system failing to work as expected. If I remove the SIM card PIN, as suggested, I end up losing mobile network signal and cannot set up mobile data either. Any support would be greatly appreciated, as I'm currently stuck and unable to proceed.

analysis.insight_summary: A user experienced reduced functionality when upgrading from an older to a newer [product_name], losing the ability to specify the message center phone number necessary for SMS messaging. This leads to the system being unusable and adds frustration. Attempts to resolve the issue by removing the SIM PIN only result in a loss of mobile signal and inability to set up mobile data.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the new [product_name] to retain the ability to enter and use a message center phone number for SMS messaging, as was possible in the previous version. They anticipate a straightforward configuration experience without losing key features.
